properties.name: subtitle
properties.description:
A quieter line under the title — a source, a unit, the caveat a title
should not have to carry.

properties.name: titleAlign
properties.description: Title alignment over the plot: `start` (left), `center`, or `end` (right).

properties.name: xAxis
properties.description: Category axis configuration.

properties.name: yAxis
properties.description: Value axis configuration.

properties.name: yAxis2
properties.description:
A SECOND value axis, drawn in the opposite gutter and used by any series
whose `yAxisIndex` is 1 — two quantities on one category axis that share no
scale, like a count and a rate. Vertical charts.

It draws no gridlines of its own: two sets at two spacings turn the plot
into a mesh nobody can read a value off.

properties.name: layout
properties.description: Bar layout — `'horizontal'` swaps categories onto the y axis.

properties.name: stack
properties.description: Stacking strategy: none (grouped) / normal / percentage.

properties.name: categoryGap
properties.description: Category gap as a percentage of the band width (`"30%"` or `30`).

properties.name: barGap
properties.description: Bar gap between sibling grouped bars (`"20%"` or `20`).

properties.name: barWidth
properties.description:
Fixed bar WIDTH in px, centred in each slot. Default: auto — the bar fills
its slot (the band minus the category/bar gaps). Clamped to the slot so it
can't overrun a neighbour.

properties.name: cornerRadius
properties.description: Bar corner radius in pixels.

properties.name: zoom
properties.description:
Interactive zoom over the CATEGORY range — the same "zoom is a view" model
as `md-line-chart`:
  • `inside` — drag horizontally across the plot to zoom into that span of
    bars; double-click the plot to reset.
  • `slider` — a range slider under the plot; drag its thumbs to resize the
    window, or the grip between them to pan it.
  • `both` — both gestures.

`series` / `xAxis` are never mutated: the engine is simply fed the sliced
window, and hover / click / keyboard indices are rebased so consumers still
see ABSOLUTE data indices. Ignored on a `polar` chart (a ring has no span to
zoom). For a *value*-range zoom, set `yAxis.min` / `yAxis.max`.

properties.name: locale
properties.description:
BCP-47 locale for the DEFAULT number / date formatting (axis ticks,
tooltip values, screen-reader table). Empty follows the browser; an
explicit `valueFormatter` always wins.

properties.name: tooltipRenderer
properties.description: Replace the tooltip's content. See `md-line-chart`'s `tooltipRenderer`.

properties.name: noAnimation
properties.description: Disable all animation (shorthand for `animation="none"`).

properties.name: animation
properties.description: Entry-animation variant: `expressive` (default), `grow`, `fade`, `draw`, or `none`.

properties.name: animationDuration
properties.description: Entry-animation duration override in ms (≤ 0 disables).

properties.name: showLabels
properties.description: Show numeric data labels on each bar.

properties.name: showTotals
properties.description:
Print each stack's TOTAL past the end of the column, alongside the
per-segment values `show-labels` prints inside it. Stacked charts only —
an unstacked bar already IS its total.

properties.name: chevron
properties.description:
Draw the bars as CHEVRONS pointing away from the baseline instead of as
rectangles. Along a stack they interlock, each segment's point sitting in
the next one's notch — a force diagram, where the contributions are handed
along in a direction rather than merely piled up.

properties.name: polar
properties.description:
Wrap the bars around a circle: one concentric RING per category, with the
value axis running as an ANGLE instead of a length. A radial (polar) bar
chart.

Stacking, legend hiding and percentage normalisation all work unchanged —
only the step from a value to geometry differs, and the value axis
deliberately spans less than the full circle, since a ring that closes on
itself has no readable start or end. The quarter it gives up is where the
category names go; `polar-sweep` changes how much that is.

properties.name: polarHole
properties.description: Radius of the hole at the centre of a polar chart, 0..0.9. Default 0.22.

properties.name: polarSweep
properties.description: Fraction of the circle the value axis spans on a polar chart. Default 0.75.

properties.name: axisTicks
properties.description: Draw small perpendicular tick marks on the axes.

properties.name: clickable
properties.description:
Show a hand (`pointer`) cursor over the bars, signalling they're actionable —
e.g. clickable to drill into. The chart can't know an interaction is wired,
so set this when a `mdBarClick` handler does something (like `drill`). The
cursor tracks the bar itself (hit-tested like a click), not the empty column
above a short bar.

properties.name: labelZoomStart
properties.description: Accessible label for the zoom slider's start thumb.

properties.name: labelZoomEnd
properties.description: Accessible label for the zoom slider's end thumb.

properties.name: labelPlot
properties.default: 'Chart data. Use the arrow keys to move between points, Home and End for the first and last, Escape to leave.'
properties.defaultValue: Chart data. Use the arrow keys to move between points, Home and End for the first and last, Escape to leave.
properties.description:
Instructions announced when the plot receives keyboard focus. The plot is
focusable so a keyboard user can walk the data with the arrow keys; this
is what tells them so.

properties.name: labelPoint
properties.description:
Template for the live announcement as keyboard focus moves. `%x%` is the
axis value, `%values%` the series readings at it.

properties.name: loading
properties.description:
Data is still on its way — the chart covers the plot with a loader instead
of drawing an empty (or stale) axis, and marks itself `aria-busy`.

Set it while the fetch is in flight and clear it when `series` arrives; the
entry animation replays on the way out, so the bars draw themselves in
rather than appearing fully formed. Slot `loading` to replace the default
indicator with your own skeleton.

properties.name: loadingLabel
properties.description: Accessible + visible text under the loader.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Bar Chart
description: Compare values across categories. Vertical or horizontal bars, grouped or stacked, with legend, tooltips, zoom, drill-down, a polar (radial) mode and an expressive entrance animation.

notes: Native Canvas grouped vertical bars. Stacking, polar, inverted/horizontal layout, custom axes and zoom not implemented. Tap probes first series.

Native Material/Compose appearance; CSS selectors, DOM APIs, form association, cancelable DOM events and source imperative methods are not compiled. Unsupported source properties are reported by the compiler.
Native Canvas baseline: index-based linear plotting and simple hit selection. Advanced scales, curves, stacking, zoom, exact source tooltip/hit-test/event payload parity remain incomplete.
